steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: It's coming... The monster... will die... no escape...
Ragnar's condition deteriorates further. Something squirms beneath his skin, and his delirious mutterings become increasingly coherent.
But you don't have the luxury to worry about him now. Maneuvering through the darkness saps your energy and mental acuity, demanding continual vigilance against the monster's abrupt assaults.
Never in your life have you wished so desperately for a vessel to move faster.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Incoming... from the left!
You execute an immediate maneuver, evading the monster's onslaught.

Through the porthole, you catch sight of the monster's incomplete form, marred by the explosion. However, its fractured tentacles and mangled shape have not impeded its pursuit—if anything, the damage has rendered it even more fearsome.
Its damaged tentacles reach out, catching the rear propeller. The entire submarine lurches to a stop, nearly ejecting you from the pilot's seat.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I'll lure it away!
Pylgia tries her old trick again, raising the searchlight high to draw the monster's attention.
But this time, the monster ignores the glowing "insect" before it, focusing all its attacks on the submarine instead.
With a bone-chilling screech of rending metal, one of the propellers is torn clean off, as more tentacles coil around the submarine's stern.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The sub will be immobilized at this rate!

Pylgia knows full well how dire the situation is. Realizing the monster won't target her, she opts for a more audacious approach—forsaking evasion and defense to mount a full-scale assault with her harpoon.
With a single shot, the tiny harpoon severs a tentacle thicker than Pylgia's entire body from the submarine's tail fin.
However, it's far from killing it—the monster has too many tentacles.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This isn't working. We need to hit its vital point.
However, the monster's body remains entirely shielded behind countless tentacles. There is no torpedo remaining, and Pylgia is no longer able to divert the monster's attention.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Let me be the bait. You find an opening to strike.
Pylgia catches your intention in no time.

You shut down the rear engine and activate the lateral propellers, rotating the helm to its limit. The submarine executes a full 180-degree turn in the water, compelling the entangled tentacles to coil along with it. Unable to retain their grip, the tentacles briefly lose their grasp on the vessel.
The submarine's bow now faces directly at the monster's body.
The steel vessel charges forward at full throttle, ripping a path through the monster's fleshy tentacles.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now!
Surrounded by drifting plankton, Pylgia's figure transforms into a white meteor, plunging swiftly through the breach in the tentacles and directly towards the monster's exposed body.
